notes.title: Release of Chronicles of cyberpunk - Deep sleep
notes.notes:
Hi all. The game Chronicles of cyberpunk - Deep sleep was released after 4.5 years of development and is already available to everyone for free. Immerse yourself in an adventure where you once again have to confront Big Brother and the Supercomputer in a mysterious and unusual world

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31199973/2d321192d405c58347f0442455140b1ee1446f46.jpg

In the meantime, I'm starting work on the next game - the third and final part of the trilogy. This will be the climax, completing the plot and giving answers to many questions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433000/Chronicles_of_cyberpunk__Deep_sleep/
